name: Soul of the Druid
body:
Associated Skills: Handle Animal, Knowledge (nature), Survival, Ride

Associated Veils: Brume Treads, Cloak of Thorns, Heart of Yggdrasil, H’s Flowered Regalia, Nymph’s Visage, Priestess’ Clasp of Rebirth, Snakehandler’s Gauntlets, Verdant Vambraces

Animal Companion (Ex)

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the druid allows you to conjure the spirit of an animal to aid you. This functions as an animal companion, using your soulforge level as your effective druid level, save that the animal is an Outsider with the Native subtype and does not gain the share spells ability.

This change in type does not affect its attributes or its Hit Dice. You can choose a new animal companion using this ability each time you shape your veils or forge this soul. You cannot apply animal companion archetypes to this animal companion. If your animal companion is slain, it is returned to life the next time you rest and shape your veils. When you forge a new soul, you lose your animal companion. If you forge multiple souls that grant you an animal companion, you only gain one animal companion. If the animal companion is modified by your souls, it receives all of the modifications as long as they do not conflict.

Woodland Stride (Ex)

At 3rd level, you may move through any sort of undergrowth (such as natural thorns, briars, overgrown areas, and similar terrain) at your normal speed and without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Thorns, briars, and overgrown areas that have been magically manipulated to impede motion, however, still affect you.

Trackless Step (Ex)

At 3rd level, you leave no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked. You may choose to leave a trail if so desired.
